paper.title_en: Quasinormal modes response to thermodynamic phase transitions in the charged AdS black hole surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter
paper.abstract_en: We investigate how thermodynamic phase transitions are reflected in the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). In the extended phase space, increasing the positive PFDM parameter raises the critical temperature and pressure while reducing the critical horizon radius. We compute the fundamental QNMs of a massless scalar perturbation using a Chebyshev pseudospectral method and analyze their evolution along isobaric and isothermal processes below the critical point. The small and large black hole branches trace clearly separated QNM trajectories and display sharply different slopes near the first-order transition, providing a dynamical signature of the branch change. Along isotherms, this evolution results from the competing effects of the horizon radius and pressure, or equivalently the AdS radius, rather than from the horizon radius alone. At the critical point, however, the QNM frequencies vary smoothly with the horizon radius and show no sharp signature of the second-order transition. Along the coexistence curve, the separation between the small and large black hole QNMs decreases as the Gibbs free energy swallowtail shrinks and vanishes at criticality. These results show that PFDM shifts both the thermodynamic phase structure and the associated QNM response, while the fundamental scalar QNM spectrum remains sensitive to the first-order small/large black hole transition.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究带电AdS黑洞在完美流体暗物质环境中的热力学相变与拟正规模的关系，属于黑洞热力学范畴，提供了新的动力学探针，方法严谨，结果明确。
decision.title_zh: 完美流体暗物质包围的带电AdS黑洞中热力学相变的拟正规模响应
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究带电反德西特(AdS)黑洞被完美流体暗物质(PFDM)包围时，热力学相变如何反映在拟正规模(QNMs)中。在扩展相空间中，增大正PFDM参数会提高临界温度和压力，同时减小临界视界半径。我们使用切比雪夫伪谱方法计算无质量标量扰动的基本QNMs，并分析它们在临界点以下的等压和等温过程中的演化。小黑洞和大黑洞分支描绘出清晰分离的QNM轨迹，并在一级相变附近显示出明显不同的斜率，提供了分支变化的动力学特征。沿等温线，这种演化是由视界半径和压力(或等效地AdS半径)的竞争效应引起的，而不是仅由视界半径决定。然而在临界点，QNM频率随视界半径平滑变化，没有显示二级相变的尖锐特征。沿共存曲线，小黑洞和大黑洞QNM之间的分离随着吉布斯自由能的燕尾形收缩而减小，并在临界点消失。这些结果表明，PFDM同时改变了热力学相结构和相关的QNM响应，而基本标量QNM谱仍然对一级小/大黑洞转变敏感。
